## Validation and limitations

The strategy retrieved all 14 records in the screened development set (100% relative recall on that set). This is not independent validation or an estimate of sensitivity. The lifestyle and well-being block was tested but left out: it reduced results by 88.3%, while only 14 known relevant records were available—below the skill’s threshold for safely requiring that optional block. Its 30-record loss sample contained no relevant records, but that sample is weak evidence.

The resulting 123,001 records exceed the default 10,000-record workload budget. Generic pandemic, quarantine, lockdown, and distancing terms can also retrieve unrelated records, so screen for relevance to COVID-19 and the specified outcomes. The internal critic passed; the strategy still needs human PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
